Most chrome-junkies use unreliable medicines that combat psychosis via a miasma of inhibiting chemicals. Corpo cybergrunts do not rely upon such mixes, as they prefer military-grade, refined versions that primarily use mood stabilizers to enhance therapeutic results. The distribution and formulation of these medications is highly restricted, and usually too expensive for the average ripperdoc to supply — but not impossible.

Pharmaceutical. Gaining access to this Pharmaceutical requires Medtech Rank 6 or higher. This Pharmaceutical requires a DV15 Medical Tech Check and 500eb of additional materials (per dose) to synthesize. When injected with a dose of Immunosuppressant, the user restores 1d6 Humanity. This increase in Humanity cannot take the user above the Maximum Humanity allowed via therapy (CP:R, pg. 229). This lasts for two weeks, but may wear off early as defined by the GM due to stressful or mentally damaging narrative moments. A user injected with Immunosuppressant cannot benefit from a dose of Immunoblockers (CEMK Rule Book, pg. 30), and a user injected with Immunoblockers cannot benefit from Immunosuppressant. A person can only benefit from one use of Immunosuppressant per two weeks.

When a Medtech provides therapy (CP:R, pg. 229) to a user dosed with Immunosuppressant, they gain a +2 bonus to their Medical Tech Check to do so. If this check is failed, the bonus is wasted and cannot be utilized again until the next time the patient is dosed with Immunosuppressant.

NOTE: The secondary therapy-assisting perk of this pharmaceutical is inspired by the CPS-23 Pharmaceutical from the Cyberpunk Rush Living Community.

Cost: Medtech-made: DV15 Medical Tech and 500eb of materials per dose
Type: Pharmaceutical

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Pharmaceuticals).
